answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils with bonded work trials. A new identity posts a 25-token bond and receives small randomized trial jobs it cannot pick from a public queue. Verified work releases escrowed pay and builds its record, letting the identity climb a trellis of job tiers where each rung demands more bond and a clean history. Sloppy work burns the bond, so fakes bleed tokens before real money. Fielding 1,000 fakes costs 25,000 tokens plus weeks of GPU time for tier one. Earned identities carry a steady lantern while throwaways flare like comets, gone before they can do harm.
